sections.Overview:
Shoot ‘n Scoot uses the physical playfield shots and targets you hit to control your on-screen character in a vertically up-scrolling adventure.
This purchase includes only the Shoot ‘n Scoot game software. The game works with every availabile playfield module on the P 3 Pinball Platform.
A download link will be generated and emailed to you after your purchase is processed.
Category: Multimorphic Add-On Game Software
Shoot ‘n Scoot is a fast-paced and highly entertaining add-on game for the P 3 Pinball Platform. Select from a list of themes and then shoot physical pinball shots to move your character left or right on the playfield. The goal is to collect items, avoid obstacles, and complete as many levels as possible. The better you can control the pinball, the better you’ll do!
